resources.string: One tap to play your audiobook in Spotify
Which audiobook should the widget play?
In Spotify, open the audiobook, tap Share → Audiobook Button. Or paste a link here.
Not a recognized Spotify link (expected open.spotify.com/audiobook/…)
Then long-press your home screen → Widgets → Audiobook Button.
Spotify didn\'t respond; opening the book instead
Log in to the Spotify app first
%1$s is playing on %2$s. Play %3$s on this phone instead? That will stop it there.
On: the widget\'s button becomes Stop while Spotify is playing on this phone.
To turn the widget\'s Play button into Stop while Spotify plays on this phone, allow notification access. The app only watches Spotify\'s playback state.
If the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"): open App info for Audiobook Button → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
